description: This file defines a template interface IIteratorType within the WPEFramework::RPC namespace. The interface provides methods for iterating over a collection of elements, including navigation (Next, Previous, Reset), validation (IsValid), size (Count), and access to the current element (Current).

classes.name: IIteratorType
classes.description: A template interface for iterating over elements, providing iteration and access methods, identified by an INTERFACE_ID.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next element, outputting it via the reference parameter.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves the iterator to the previous element, outputting it via the reference parameter.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a specified position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of elements in the collection.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current element pointed to by the iterator.
